claims.claim: You can apply for Scottish Child Payment online.
claims.quote: You can apply online here if you want to make a new application for Scottish Child Payment.
claims.note: The page explicitly offers a new online application.

claims.claim: You can apply for Scottish Child Payment by phone.
claims.quote: Call Social Security Scotland free on 0800 182 2222 to make your application over the phone.
claims.note: The page explicitly offers a phone application.

claims.claim: You or your partner can qualify by getting Universal Credit or income-based Jobseeker’s Allowance.
claims.quote: if you or your partner are getting one or more of the following benefits: Universal Credit income-based Jobseeker's Allowance (JSA)
claims.note: The source names both benefits and either partner.

claims.claim: For Pension Credit, Income Support or income-related ESA, the applicant alone must be named on the benefit.
claims.quote: Social Security Scotland also accept claims if you alone are named on one of these benefits: Pension Credit Income Support income-related Employment and Support Allowance (ESA)
claims.note: The source names the three benefits and the applicant-only condition.

claims.claim: Child Benefit alone does not qualify.
claims.quote: Child benefit on its own is not an accepted benefit for Scottish Child Payment.
claims.note: The source explicitly excludes Child Benefit on its own.

claims.claim: You may apply while waiting for a decision on a qualifying benefit.
claims.quote: If you're not getting any of these benefits or payments, but have applied for one, you can still apply for Scottish Child Payment.
claims.note: The source allows a claim after applying for a qualifying benefit.
The source lists Scottish residence among the conditions.

claims.claim: You must provide proof of a qualifying benefit.
claims.quote: You need to send us some information with your application that shows us details of the sanction or deduction. This can be a copy of any of these: a Universal Credit statement a Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) benefit award letter
claims.note: Benefit documents are required when a sanction or deduction must be shown, but the page does not require benefit proof in every application.

claims.claim: You must provide the child’s details.
claims.quote: the names and dates of birth of the children you want to add
claims.note: The application page lists names and dates of birth for children being added.
